English.Char_Desc_2000:
Dating Photographs reads the dates written on your old photos, on the front, the white border or the back (scanned as its own file), and renames each photo by its date, like 1998-10-01.jpg, in a Dated Photographs folder, so sorted by name they are in date order. It reads handwriting and print, and the orange date a film camera printed in the corner. Oct-98, 98-Oct, June 12, 1975, 3/15/91, Christmas 1987 and Summer '82 all become dates; a date with no day gets the 1st. You check each date before anything moves: click a photo to see it, with a box round the words its date came from, type a different date, or untick it to leave it where it is. Options: keep the old name after the date, a folder for each year, set each photo's Date taken so photo programs sort it right, and print the date on the photo in orange like a film camera, keeping an untouched copy. Undo the last move puts everything back. Every move is listed in a file Excel opens. The reading happens on this computer; nothing is uploaded. Everything it needs is included.
Before you install: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The installer is not code-signed (a signing certificate is a paid yearly service), so Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box: click More info, then Run anyway. A few antivirus programs wrongly flag new unsigned programs; you can check the download against the SHA-256 fingerprint on its release page. No administrator password is needed.
